label: Classifier-free guidance pushes past the condition
context: 2D plane with an unconditional data distribution of three clusters (grey contours), one of them is the conditioned class 'fox' (blue). A noisy point x. Draw two arrows from x: the unconditional prediction D(x, σ | ∅) (grey, pointing toward the overall mean) and the conditional prediction D(x, σ | c) (blue, toward the fox cluster). Then animate the guidance weight w from 1 to 7 with a slider: the guided prediction D_w = D(∅) + w·(D(c) − D(∅)) is drawn warm #B4552F and extends past the conditional arrow. Phase 2: show samples generated at w = 1 (spread over the fox cluster) versus w = 7 (crowded into a tight clump at the far edge of the cluster). Caption: 'higher w: more on-prompt, less diverse'. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 400 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 10 to 16 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Use plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: Classifier-free guidance extrapolates past the conditional prediction
spec.caption: higher w: more on-prompt, less diverse
